branches.conclusion: FEG and IMPGT broad management doctorates plus the actual IAE Aix PhD Programme in Management and CERGAM doctoral research-area list were read. The AMU-awarded IAE credential is Sciences de Gestion (broad management sciences), and CERGAM fields are finance, HR, leadership, public management, marketing, international management, strategy, information systems, innovation and entrepreneurship. No formally named Operations, quantitative Management Science or Industrial Engineering doctoral title/area appears in these current business doctoral host pages.

Official Faculty of Sciences doctoral-school inventory and ED353 engineering themes were read previously; current ED184 Mathematics/Informatics admissions page was read 26 October. It names Mathematics, numerical analysis, scientific computing, probability/statistics, discrete mathematics, fundamental informatics and information/systems science as intake disciplines, but no formal Ops/quantitative MS/IE field. Doctoral specialties across all technical hosts and schools remain incompletely inventoried; no university-wide negative claim.
